text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert P-9X2J fired for service=inference-prod, symptom=error-rate > 8% over 2m, priority=high. Triggered by route /v1/generate. Escalation policy: primary -> secondary -> manager. Link: https://pd.example/P-9X2J

pagerduty: Page sent to primary on-call (sara-oncall) at 1809001234 — no ack within 4m, auto-escalating to secondary.

sara-oncall: sorry team, am on commute. can't access laptop for a few mins, marking as missed ack :disappointed:

david-sre: ack'ing now — taking first responder. quick read: spike of 500s coming from a subset of customers hitting long prompts. seeing KV-cache pressure and GPU OOM-ish failures in pods inference-pool-3.

liam-eng: copying logs from one of the failing instances:
```
[2026-03-14T18:05:12Z] ERROR tok=12345 inference/runtime.cpp: oom while allocating kv_cache 439MB
[2026-03-14T18:05:13Z] WARN request_router: retrying request route=/v1/generate user=acme-corp
```

david-sre: mitigation plan: 1) temporarily scale up dedicated pool by +2 GPUs (in progress), 2) enable degraded-routing -> route heavy prompt customers to smaller model variant (redwood-small) as fallback, 3) increase per-request token cap to avoid runaway long sequences for now. will kick off canary traffic to confirm.

amanda-manager: paging as manager because secondary escalation fired and customer-impact flagged (acme-corp SLA). please add CxOps and AM on call. @liam-eng @sara-oncall keep me updated. :phone:

liam-eng: doing a quick config flip to enable fallback routing. command I'm running:
```bash
redwoodctl routing set-policy --service inference-prod --policy fallback-to=redwood-small --weight=0.2
```

sara-oncall: I'm about to handoff — drive-by ack earlier, but David is active. taking notes for postmortem. handing to david and amanda as incident leads.

david-sre: scale request accepted by infra-autoscaler, 2 GPUs provisioning (est 90s). flipped fallback policy weight to 30% on canary hosts. monitoring request success rate.

pagerduty: Escalation: Manager page sent to amanda-manager at 1809001320 because secondary acked but incident not mitigated within 8m.

amanda-manager: Received manager page, confirming customer impact & SLA risk. I notified CxOps and legal. asking CS to prepare customer note template: short outage, mitigation steps, ETA to full recovery ~20-30m.

liam-eng: after fallback flip, 5xxs dropped from 8.7% -> 2.1% on canary. GPU memory still high on some pods; continuing to drain worst offenders and rotate in healthy nodes.

david-sre: rolling restart on inference-pool-3 underway for pods with repeated OOMs. observed transient latency bump but lower error rate.

incident-bot: Incident timeline: P-9X2J fired 1809001234, primary missed ack 1809001474, secondary ack 1809001480, manager escalated 1809001320. Current status: mitigation in-progress, partial fallback applied, scaling in-flight.

amanda-manager: Good progress. once scaled capacity stabilizes and error-rate <1% for 10m, we'll notify CxOps to send interim customer update. also scheduling an on-call handoff at +30m for long tail.

sara-oncall: thanks team, will join remote and help with post-incident runbook.

david-sre: marking incident as active, next updates every 5m or on any regression. prepping a concise incident summary for the notes channel when we reach steady state. :white_check_mark: 

liam-eng: note for postmortem: consider KV cache size caps per-request and smarter eviction to prevent cascading OOMs during bursty long prompts. also revisit routing thresholds for heavy customers.

incident-bot: auto-update scheduled in 5 minutes. If unresolved in 30 minutes, PagerDuty will auto-escalate to on-call manager rotation.
